correctness.rationale: Each random rule orientation defines n equalities x_i=x_{i+sigma_i}; for a nonconstant orientation the functional neighbor graph has one weak component per + to - adjacent directed 2-cycle, whereas either uniform orientation has one full n-cycle. The transfer-matrix trace with T=[[lambda,2(1-lambda)],[lambda,1-lambda]] plus two uniform-orientation corrections equals 2^n times extinction probability. Its spectral recurrence S_n(t)+S_n(-t), t=lambda(1-lambda), has only positive even powers t^{2j}; n=3 flat, n>=4 strictly increasing, hence sole optimum lambda=1/2 and endpoints minima. Dominant alpha_plus>1 proves large-n exponential ratio. An independently coded exhaustive update enumeration versus exact rational polynomial passed 30 size/mix comparisons; infinite claim is analytic.
